name: 根目錄不存在／OneDrive 未完整落地
solution: 讀取根目錄與連結狀態，明列未覆蓋範圍；保留分母
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: Python／PowerShell／套件缺失
solution: 能力檢測；缺原生 PS parser 或 Parquet reader 保留未驗狀態
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: 主控版本已升級或相容鏈不成立
solution: 接受已知 v0192／v0193；新尾版與同版異內容停止套用
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: SSOT 結構漂移／重號／多主控來源
solution: 欄位與 station ID 檢查；主控根多義時停止寫入
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: 掃描或套用期間來源變動
solution: 穩定讀取、前後 SHA256 與發布前重新核對
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: 崩潰遺留鎖／多程序同時升級
solution: OS 鎖隨程序死亡釋放；原生根與輸出目錄均獨占
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: 磁碟不足／輸出寫到一半
solution: 空間預留；完整 generation 才更新 current 指標
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: 安裝中斷留下半套檔案
solution: 先寫 journal 與 staged 檔，主入口最後發布；復原只處理雜湊及檔案身分相符項
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: 註冊只成功一半或執行結果不明
solution: 逐步收據續跑；RUNNING 中斷先核對，不盲目重播
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: 快取損毀／舊解析器結果誤用
solution: SQLite integrity、逐筆 checksum、隔離壞庫並重建
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: 單檔 AST 失控／記憶體不足
solution: 變更檔獨立子程序、有界併行與逾時；Linux 加記憶體上限，失敗保留分母
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: PowerShell 一個壞檔拖垮整批
solution: 失敗批次二分拆解到單檔，未取得原生 AST 不算通過
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: 命令卡死／取消留下子程序
solution: 逾時與中斷均清理自己的程序樹，保留日誌與退出碼
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: 重複工作／半寫 JSON／偽造指令
solution: allowlist、session、檔名 ID、防重播與寫入安定期；不覆寫已成功收據
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: 來源／資料／環境已變，仍沿用舊綠燈
solution: 雜湊、環境、規則、有效期失效；新掃描重算證據
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: exit 0／假斷言／NaN 被當作正確結果
solution: 嚴格 JSON、預期與實際值核對、工具探針型別限制
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: 429／5xx／連線逾時與重試風暴
solution: 既有 governed transport 可選用有界退避；401／403／PermissionError 即停止
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: 工具雜湊不符／API 不相容
solution: 鎖版與呼叫結果檢查；缺件降級本地掃描，不繞網路政策
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: 前端讀舊資料／session 過期／JSON 不相容
solution: current manifest 與內容 SHA256、版本與 schema 檢查；session 重新讀取
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate

name: 新增功能漏登／連續更新觸發掃描風暴
solution: AST＋原生 station 差異清冊；穩定兩次觀測與冷卻後自動重掃
control_scope: isolated fault tests; production validation separate
